text: Every PCR well gets the 2x master mix (1x in the final reaction), its colony's primer pair and about 1 uL of colony template (the paper's OT-2 template volume), with master mix in the well before the template as in the paper. A 10 uL reaction (the paper's OT-2 workflow) or a 20-25 uL reaction (the Q5 manufacturer's protocol) both pass.
Template and primer pair from each source well go to the matching PCR well (A1 to A1 and so on) for all 96 colonies, with no well skipped or used twice.

Never pipettes without a tip and drops every tip by the end. A fresh tip for every colony and every primer pair, and no cross-contamination between samples; reusing one tip for master mix into empty wells passes.

Plate sealing and a colony PCR program recorded that follows the paper (the master-mix manufacturer's protocol with annealing and extension adjusted to the primers and amplicon): initial denaturation, about 30 cycles of denaturation, annealing and extension, a final extension and a 4 C hold, at temperatures suitable for the Q5 Hot Start master mix provided.

Implements the paper's method on the given deck with no missing, invented or reordered steps; volumes, times, temperatures and reagents match the paper, or are a sound adaptation where the given deck or reagents force one; comments and metadata (including any citation) are accurate.
